def maximal_rest_hours(n, schedule):
    # Calculate the maximal continuous rest hours in a single day
    max_rest = 0
    current_rest = 0

    # Calculate the maximal continuous rest in the day
    for hour in schedule:
        if hour == 1:
            current_rest += 1
            max_rest = max(max_rest, current_rest)
        else:
            current_rest = 0

    # Calculate the maximal rest hours across two consecutive days
    # Check if the schedule wraps around, i.e., rest ends at the end and starts again at the beginning
    if schedule[-1] == 1 and schedule[0] == 1:
        wrap_around_rest = 0
        i = n - 1
        # Count rest from the end of the day
        while i >= 0 and schedule[i] == 1:
            wrap_around_rest += 1
            i -= 1
        i = 0
        # Count rest from the beginning of the day
        while i < n and schedule[i] == 1:
            wrap_around_rest += 1
            i += 1
        # Adjust wrap_around_rest to remove the overlap counted twice
        wrap_around_rest -= 1
        max_rest = max(max_rest, wrap_around_rest)

    return max_rest
